description: What a project is: its name and main scene from project.godot, the Godot that answers, and how many scenes, scripts and assets (images, fonts, sound, models, video and shaders) it holds, other counting every remaining file. No count includes the .import and .uid files the engine writes beside others, the addons gdharness installed, or any file in a folder holding a .gdignore. Optional sections go on top. A class_name the project's class list lacks is put in it before the engine runs, and classesRebuiltFirst names it.

addonClasses.description: For classes: the addons, by their folder under res://addons, whose classes are listed by name and script like the project's own, rather than counted under inAddons. Default none. Addon classes can outnumber the project's own many times over.

detail.description: full adds what to do about it to every validation finding. Read only with validation in include, and refused without it. Default summary.

include.description: Extra sections: registered autoloads, the classes the project's scripts declare with class_name, each with its script, read from the files (those an addon declares counted per addon under inAddons, unless addonClasses names the addon), the input actions project.godot holds with their events (an engine ui_ action only when the project rebinds it, as engineAction), addons and whether each is enabled, export presets (runnable marks the one preset of its platform the editor's one-click deploy uses), the audio bus layout, a health report, or export validation. health and validation compile every script of the project in headless engines and name each that fails with its first error, each file a scene, resource or script refers to that does not exist, each input action a script reads by a name written in the call that neither the project nor the engine defines, with every line reading it, and each signal connection in a scene whose method or signal the node at its end does not have, or whose method takes a number of arguments other than the connection passes, judged from the node's type and scripts as their files are written. health's score starts at 100 and loses points for each finding by its weight, 15 for a main scene that does not exist and 5 for a broken connection. Its grade is A from 90 down to F below 60, so a failed check can still grade A. Notes such as TODO in scripts under addons/ are left out, as their authors' work.

preset.description: For validation: the export preset to validate against.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.
